operational_one_to_one_7_species.definition: Constructed directly from archived Orthogroups.tsv; retain only rows with exactly one non-empty member in each of seven species columns.

target_three_operational_one_to_one.definition: Exactly one member in the Liriodendron chinense reference, Castanea mollissima, and Vitis vinifera columns; other four reference species unconstrained.

cula_picea_operational_pairwise_one_to_o.definition: Exactly one member in Cunninghamia lanceolata and Picea abies; orthology resource only and outside the primary 24-contrast DEG scope.

supplementary_tables.S4_verification_status: not claimed; stage mappings documented without unverified independent-review fields

notes: All database-scale counts use one deduplicated RNA-seq reporting scope that includes the four core projects used by the expression-query subset.
PRJNA972435 was excluded because its public ScientificName is the unresolved non-species-level label 'plant metagenome'.
The DEG threshold is padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1.
Coexpression relationships are associative and are not experimentally validated regulatory interactions.
Picea abies remains available for expression browsing and is outside the 24-contrast gene-level DEG scope.
